recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: job = a job posting (charged). company_summary and error rows are free.

contentKey.title: Content key
contentKey.description: Hash of normalized title + company + raw location + requisition id. Same role listed twice shares it.

changeHash.title: Change hash
changeHash.description: Hash of the material fields. Changes when the posting is materially edited.

provider.title: ATS provider
provider.description: Which applicant tracking system the posting came from.

companySlug.title: Company slug
companySlug.description: The ATS board identifier used to fetch this job.

company.title: Company
company.description: Company display name as reported by the ATS. Null for Lever and Ashby, whose public job-board APIs publish no company name — use companySlug there.

companyDomain.title: Company domain
companyDomain.description: Website domain from the ATS directory when known. Null when unknown.

titleNormalized.title: Normalized title
titleNormalized.description: Lowercased title with trailing location, req id and remote markers stripped. Used for content dedupe.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department as reported by the ATS.

team.title: Team
team.description: Sub-team when the ATS reports one (Ashby, Lever).

locationRaw.title: Location (raw)
locationRaw.description: Untouched location string from the ATS.

city.title: City
city.description: Parsed city. Null when the location text has no recognizable city.

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Always upper-case, for every provider.

locations.title: All locations
locations.description: Every location attached to the posting, parsed the same way as the primary one.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: True only when remote could be positively determined. Null means unknown, never assumed false.

workplaceType.title: Workplace type
workplaceType.description: onsite, hybrid or remote when determinable.

remoteSource.title: Remote detected from
remoteSource.description: Which rule set the remote flag: ats, location, title, description, or null.

employmentTypeRaw.title: Employment type (raw)
employmentTypeRaw.description: Original value from the ATS before normalization.

employmentTypeSource.title: Employment type source
employmentTypeSource.description: ats = reported by the ATS itself. title = inferred from the job title. Null = unknown. strictEmploymentType keeps only ats.

seniority.title: Seniority
seniority.description: Seniority exactly as the ATS reports it. Never inferred. Personio only today.

yearsOfExperience.title: Years of experience
yearsOfExperience.description: Experience band as the ATS reports it. Never inferred.

salaryMin.title: Salary min
salaryMin.description: Lower bound of the published pay range.

salaryMax.title: Salary max
salaryMax.description: Upper bound of the published pay range.

salarySource.title: Salary source
salarySource.description: ats = structured field from the ATS. parsed = extracted from the ad text by regex. Null = no salary found.

salaryRaw.title: Salary (raw)
salaryRaw.description: The original salary string when the ATS provides free text.

applyUrl.title: Apply URL
applyUrl.description: Direct application link when the ATS exposes one, otherwise the job URL. For Greenhouse this duplicates the job URL — the ATS exposes no separate apply link.

postedAt.title: Posted at
postedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Null when the ATS publishes no posting date.

postedAtSource.title: Posted-at source
postedAtSource.description: Which ATS field the date came from, or null when the ATS has none.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC of the last ATS-side update, when reported.

descriptionHtml.title: Description (HTML)
descriptionHtml.description: Job ad body as the employer's own HTML, not sanitised. Escape it before you render it. Present only when includeDescription is on.

descriptionText.title: Description (text)
descriptionText.description: Job ad body as plain text. Present only when includeDescription is on.

descriptionRedacted.title: Description redacted
descriptionRedacted.description: True when email addresses or phone numbers were removed from the description body.

requisitionId.title: Requisition ID
requisitionId.description: Internal requisition number when the ATS exposes it.

sourceId.title: ATS job ID
sourceId.description: The provider's own id for this posting.

dedupedFrom.title: Deduped from
dedupedFrom.description: When content dedupe merged rows, the ATS job ids dropped into this one. A row merged after it was already pushed shows only in the summary's duplicatesDropped.

isNew.title: New since last run
isNew.description: Only set when onlyNewJobs is enabled. True = this id was not in the stored state.

firstSeenAt.title: First seen at
firstSeenAt.description: When this Actor first saw the id under your stateKey.

scrapedAt.title: Fetched at
scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the fetch.

raw.title: Raw ATS payload
raw.description: Provider object with contact-shaped fields and ad bodies removed and remaining text redacted. Present only when includeRawJson is on.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Non-fatal problems on this row, e.g. detail_failed when the description call failed but the job was still delivered.

jobsFound.title: Jobs found
jobsFound.description: company_summary only: jobs returned by the ATS before filtering.

jobsKept.title: Jobs kept
jobsKept.description: company_summary only: jobs left after filters, i.e. what was charged.

newJobs.title: New jobs
newJobs.description: company_summary only: jobs not seen in the previous run.

duplicatesDropped.title: Duplicates dropped
duplicatesDropped.description: company_summary only: rows merged away by content dedupe. Their ids are listed in dedupedFrom on the surviving job row.

trackedSince.title: Tracked since
trackedSince.description: The date this company first appeared under your stateKey. Populated when onlyNewJobs is on.

topDepartments.title: Top departments
topDepartments.description: company_summary only: most common departments with counts.

status.title: Status
status.description: company_summary and error rows: ok, not_found, unconfirmed, rate_limited, http_error, parse_error, timeout, max_jobs_reached, budget_exhausted, no_companies, unresolved_domain, provider_unavailable or provider_degraded.

error.title: Error
error.description: error rows only: short human-readable reason. Never charged.

input.title: Input value
input.description: The exact entry from your companies list that produced this row.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Job postings only, ready for a spreadsheet.

companies.title: Company summaries
companies.description: One free row per company: how many jobs were found, kept and new.
